scope: First-version platform skeleton around the frozen body and the frozen connectome module: internal energy state, a declared virtual food patch, a mouth-contact feeding gate, and a two-choice behaviour selector. No body/XML change, no new collision geometry, no neural change, no injury, no acceptance change.

what_is_engineering_and_what_is_not.connectome_module: frozen 20k strict module (192931Z core) - unchanged; currently produces no usable walking drive (rounds 10-13)
what_is_engineering_and_what_is_not.body: frozen 42-joint incremental-actuator full body, unmodified XML
what_is_engineering_and_what_is_not.energy_state: ENGINEERING rule, declared parameters, not a measured fly metabolic model
what_is_engineering_and_what_is_not.food_patch: ENGINEERING virtual volume (position + radius + mass). There is NO food geometry in the frozen body and no collision with food; feeding is gated on mouth-part proximity computed from model kinematics
what_is_engineering_and_what_is_not.feeding_gate: ENGINEERING rule: intake requires mouth-part proximity to the food patch; no chewing or proboscis mechanics exist in this body
what_is_engineering_and_what_is_not.behaviour_selector: ENGINEERING threshold rule on the declared energy state, explicitly NOT a neural circuit and NOT presented as one

why: The approved plan puts foraging, feeding, internal state and behavioural choice in the first platform version, with injury experiments only after the platform exists and the pre-injury model is frozen. Rounds 10-13 showed the connectome module cannot walk in this reconstruction, so the platform is built around that honest limitation rather than around a manufactured gait.

units_and_thresholds.energy: declared units 0..1, initial 0.6, metabolic drain 0.02 per simulated second, intake 0.25 per simulated second while the feeding gate is open, clamped to [0,1]
units_and_thresholds.food_patch: radius 0.004 native length units around a declared point; total mass 1.0, consumed at the intake rate
units_and_thresholds.forage_threshold: energy < 0.5 selects foraging; feeding requires energy < 0.95 and mouth proximity
units_and_thresholds.explicit_note: These numbers are declared engineering constants for testing platform logic; they are not calibrated to fly metabolism, food detection distance, or feeding rate.

checks_fixed_in_advance.state: energy stays inside [0,1] under drain, intake, and simultaneous drain+intake; accumulation is not double-counted
checks_fixed_in_advance.food: food mass never goes negative; intake stops at zero mass; energy cannot rise without food present
checks_fixed_in_advance.gate: feeding requires mouth proximity; without proximity energy only decreases
checks_fixed_in_advance.selector: forage/feed/rest decisions are a deterministic function of the declared state, with the exact table recorded
checks_fixed_in_advance.labels: every recorded episode states which layer produced the movement command (connectome module) and which layer produced the behaviour decision (engineering selector)

limits: This is a platform skeleton for testing state/food/behaviour wiring, not a fly. Virtual food means there is no contact mechanics with food; the connectome module does not walk; no neural claim is made for the selector, the energy model or the intake rule. No injury or surgery. Physics uses the frozen body and the frozen actuator conventions only.
not_done_here: No injury experiment, no ANN locomotion controller, no change to the connectome module, no claim that feeding is biophysically modelled.
